name: warming up in lunge (six)
description: Lunge warm-up, part 6: lower onto the forearms inside the front foot of a runner's lunge to open the hips.
instructions: Step one foot forward outside your hands and extend the rear leg behind you.
Lower onto your forearms inside the front foot, or stay on your hands if that is more comfortable.
Let your hips sink gently while keeping the front foot planted and the rear leg long.
Push back up, step out, and switch sides.
